claim: QA round 4 B1, 2026-11-07: the notification funnel's phone leg (NotificationsService.persistForRestaurant) asks ExpoPushService.pushGate(restaurantId, pushTo, ...) before its one sendToUsers call, and pushes only gate.send. The gate reads notification_preferences for those people in THAT house (push_enabled, quiet_hours_enabled/start/end, filtered on restaurant_id) and the house zone via readHouseZone; push-gate.ts holds push_enabled false back for every push (critical included), lets critical and quiet-hours-off through, does not judge the window when the house zone is null (fail open, ADR 0281 fork 1 applied funnel-wide as the session's call under the 2026-11-07 /goal), and otherwise holds a push inside isWithinQuietHours on the house clock. Read with // and /* */ comments stripped. Exit 0 on this branch; exit 1 on origin/main 259feea3f (no gate). Not checked here: notes.service.ts's own second push (TD-2026-09-26-NOTES-SERVICE-DOUBLE-PUSH-OPT-OUT-BYPASS, open), team/ shift-offer and member-left pushes that call sendToUsers directly, and what the gate does at run time - the jest spec push-follows-the-person.spec.ts covers that.
